text.en:
The following sub-paragraphs in Section Sixteen Hundred and Seventy-Four of the Revised
Administrative Code relative to the number of assistant provincial fiscals in the following provinces are
hereby amended to read as follows:
"Occidental Negros, ten assistant provincial fiscals"
"Oriental Negros, nine assistant provincial fiscals"
"Rizal, twenty-eight assistant provincial fiscals"

The same section of the Code is further amended by inserting, in the appropriate alphabetical
sequence, the following lines:
"Basilan, one assistant provincial fiscal"
"Maguindanao, two assistant provincial fiscals"
"Sultan Kudarat, two assistant provincial fiscals"
"Tawi-Tawi, two assistant provincial fiscals"

The assistant provincial fiscals mentioned above shall receive the salaries provided by law for
said positions.

Such sum as may be necessary is hereby appropriated out of any funds in the National Treasury
not otherwise appropriated for the salaries of the positions created in this Decree. Thereafter, the necessary
funds for the purpose shall be included in the annual General Appropriations Decree.

All laws, executive orders, rules and regulations, parts thereof inconsistent with this Decree are
hereby repealed and/or modified accordingly.

This Decree shall take effect immediately.
Done in the City of Manila, this 3rd day of June, in the year of Our Lord, nineteen hundred and seventy-five.
